create_output_projection: create an OutputProjection module to project node, edge, and global readout features using configurable normalization
run_output_projection_forward: run the OutputProjection forward pass with global, node, and edge readout tensors to get projected features
create_output_layer: create an OutputLayer module to produce final vector or scalar predictions from backbone features
run_output_layer_forward: run the OutputLayer forward pass on backbone feature tensors to get force or energy predictions
review_output_block_classes: review the OutputProjection and OutputLayer classes for use in ESCaIP graph neural network output heads
